annotations.title: Collect results into a My Korea link

description: 한국 여행 안내·관광 통계 (Korea Basics): Build one link from ids returned by the other tools (the `saveToMyKorea` field of their results: rules and guides, places, events, tool cards). Use it at the end of a trip-planning conversation, or whenever the user wants to keep what came up. Opening it shows the collection on Korea Basics, where the user can tap to save items to My Korea and manage them before the trip (changes to saved rules, own schedule, calendar). Nothing is saved until the user does it on the site. Takes up to 10 items (rules, guides, collections, events, tool cards) and 90 places; rules needed before departure are kept first.

topics.description: Rule, guide and collection ids, e.g. ["k-eta", "customs-allowance", "royal-palaces"].
